T3 habits, trackers, time, goals, charts and checklists: score tables

Every variant scored by python tools/screens/toast_opt.py, from drawings measured in headless Edge (360×740 phone, 1100×660 Windows). Axes are rank sums within a part, lower is better; ★ marks the Pareto front; each part's control (italics, dashed rule) was built to lose, and the run fails if it reaches the front. Grey rows failed the gate (a target under 48 dp).

Reference distance joins the axes once the reference apps are captured (t3-refs.json).

How this page is kept (owner, 2026-10-17): the newest pass first. A part still open shows its front and its control; a picked part shows only its picks; a part replaced by a later pass, or discarded, is one line naming the commit that last scored it and the JSON file where every score stays. Nothing replaced is drawn.

T3b.7f Every graph at every height: Reading (form, height, template; the note and labels one row of words below History)

144 variants and the control · 145 pass the gate · 15 on the front (★).

Axes, lower is better: Harmony = rank-sum of asym, balance_h, balance_v, rhythm, edges, void; Hierarchy = rank-sum of order_inv, prom_inv, fold_share (more is better); Fit = rank-sum of fit; Readability = rank-sum of min_font (more is better), overlaps, gcut, mark_seen (more is better), step_seen (more is better), encoding, codes; Calm = rank-sum of ink, noise_seen, compare, clutter; Mental load = rank-sum of load; Density = rank-sum of unseen, cut; Glance = rank-sum of glance (more is better); Taps = rank-sum of taps; Likeness = rank-sum of likeness; Consistency = rank-sum of consistency (more is better).

Control: a Chronicle-like page: Start and Log session, range chips, timety's chart, statistics tiles, a Goals section, the recent entries unfolded. Control lost: off the front; 144 of 144 passing variants have a lower sum.
